note: Every recipe of TF's data pack (any namespace) and every twilightforest:* recipe: type, serializer, getResultItem (id, count), width/height of shaped recipes and getIngredients() (each the item ids of Ingredient#getItems in order, tags expanded; [] = empty slot). notLoaded lists recipe files of TF's data pack the recipe manager did not load (their load conditions failed, e.g. compat recipes of absent mods).
